SELECT SDT.CARD_NO, SDT.GENERAL AS PLATE, PERSON.PERSON_NAME, SDT.CREATE_TIME, SDT.OVER_TIME FROM SMT_TASK_DOWN_RECORD SDT LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SLA. ID AS VEHICLE_ID, SLA.DRIVER_NAME AS PERSON_NAME FROM SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT SLA UNION ALL SELECT SV. ID AS VEHICLE_ID, SV.VISITOR_NAME AS PERSON_NAME FROM SMT_VISITOR SV UNION ALL SELECT SNS.VEHICLE_ID AS VEHICLE_ID, SNS."NAME" AS PERSON_NAME FROM SMT_NOT_STAFF SNS UNION ALL SELECT SVS.VEHICLE_ID AS VEHICLE_ID, SS."NAME" AS PERSON_NAME FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SVS.STAFF_ID = SS."ID" ) PERSON ON PERSON.VEHICLE_ID = SDT.CARD_NO
SDT.DEVICE_TYPE = 2 AND SDT.ACTION = 1
AND SDT.DEVICE_CODE = #{query.deviceId}
AND PERSON.PERSON_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.name}),'%')
AND SDT.GENERAL LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.plate}),'%')
ORDER BY SDT.CREATE_TIME DESC
